outcome: Composite outcome of perinatal death or prolonged exclusive total parenteral nutrition
cohort: 519 fetuses with isolated gastroschisis delivered at tertiary-level perinatal centers in Canada from 2005-2013
finding: In infants with gastroschisis, neither planned induction of labor nor planned delivery at 36-37 weeks' gestation resulted in significantly improved neonatal outcomes compared to planned vaginal delivery after spontaneous onset of labor or planned delivery at ≥38 weeks' gestation.
